hints.title: Large Bound Bitset
hints.text: Since reward values can reach 50,000, total reward can reach 100,000, which requires ultra-fast bitset arithmetic.

hints.title: Masking Strategy
hints.text: For each distinct reward v, filter reachable values < v using (1 << v) - 1, shift left by v, and bitwise OR into dp.

hints.title: Highest Set Bit
hints.text: The answer is the highest set bit in the resulting bitset integer minus 1.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Bitset operations process 64 bits per instruction.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n * M) boolean table takes 5 * 10^9 operations resulting in TLE.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(M / 64) space using native big integer bit manipulations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize bitset acceleration for high-constraint knapsack reachability.
